findings.message: All 21 promised automated tests are present with matching titles. The 9 store tests are at chat-queue-store.test.ts:297, 315, 350, 386, 414, 445, 463 and 485. The 12 worker tests are at chat-queue-worker.test.ts:51 (the existing S001 worker test), 318, 350, 378, 408, 441, 478, 513, 543, 609, 655, 690 and 719. No build record was supplied, so whether they pass is unverified. They are present but unverified, not passing.

These symbols have empty testsReaching, but they are closures nested inside createChatQueueStore and createChatQueueWorker. Both factories are reached by the test helpers repo, leased and mk. The graph does not link test cases to closures, so the empty edges reflect hollow grounding, not a confirmed gap. The promised tests cover this behaviour by name: the resend/bound test, the window-closed head tests, takeOver/reclaim and the reclaimed-lease heartbeat. This is not reported as a HIGH gap.
